tells.1: The awkward founder rationale and the tacked-on testimonial/rating details feel inserted rather than naturally integrated.
tells.2: Safe, generic phrasing and a template-like structure make it feel more functional than crafted.
tells.3: Stock motivational phrases such as 'guidance you can trust', 'real recovery', and 'unlock more of what the app has to offer'.

reason: Version 4 reads like clean, ready-to-publish App Store copy: clear, credible, and not over-written. Version 1 has more personality, but it needs editing and its extra claims make it less safe to send as-is.
